summary: DRDGOLD Limited, a South African gold producer, filed a Form 6-K on August 27, 2026, announcing the acceptance of deferred share awards under its Single Incentive Plan by directors, prescribed officers, the company secretary, and subsidiary directors. The awards, granted August 26, 2026, are deferred shares that vest over three to five years at zero exercise price, settled in ordinary shares. Deemed price per share is ZAR 36.15 based on the 7-day VWAP. This is a routine equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation or corporate action affecting shareholders. No strategic or structural changes are implied; monitoring is unnecessary.
